title: Rewire-then-Probe: A Contrastive Recipe for Probing Biomedical Knowledge of Pre-trained Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Creating and evaluating models on a 'hard query set' by filtering out knowledge queries where the answer has a high lexical overlap with the query text (measured via exact match and ROUGE-L scores) to prevent models from guessing answers based on surface forms.

Evaluating knowledge extraction using a retrieval-based contrastive probing approach (Contrastive-Probe) that compares entity representations, rather than relying on the Masked Language Modeling (MLM) head, to avoid biases stemming from different models' pre-defined vocabularies.
